meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress natural language memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into caveman format to save input tokens. Preserves all technical substance, code, URLs, and structure. Compressed version overwrites the original file. Human-readable backup saved as FILE.original.md. Trigger: /caveman-compress FILEPATH or "compress memory file"

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把长记忆文件压成精简格式，节省大模型输入额度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想给 AI 助手省些对话额度又不丢关键信息
copy.tagline_en: Condense memory files into a lean format to save AI input budget
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to trim AI context costs without losing key details

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md 等自然语言记忆文件压缩成“穴居人式”简短文字,以节省输入 token;代码、链接、路径等技术内容原样保留。压缩稿覆盖原文件,原文件备份到独立数据目录。
howto.when: 当你说“compress memory file”或类似表述要求压缩记忆文件时;也可直接输入 /caveman-compress 加文件路径触发。

say.text: 把 CLAUDE.md 压缩成穴居人风格
say.note: 触发压缩,原文件会备份到独立目录。

say.text: 压缩 preferences 文件,省点 token
say.note: 只压缩叙述文字,代码链接保留。
直接指定路径,立刻开始压缩。

howto.what_en: Compresses memory files (CLAUDE.md, todos, preferences) into terse caveman-style text to save input tokens. Code, URLs, and structure preserved exactly. Compressed version overwrites original; backup stored in separate data directory.
howto.when_en: When user types /caveman-compress <filepath> or says “compress memory file”.

say_en.text: Compress my CLAUDE.md into caveman style.
say_en.note: Triggers compression; original is backed up separately.

say_en.text: Compress the preferences file to save tokens.
say_en.note: Code, links and structure stay unchanged.
